subject: Audit & Access Log: retention windows, export formats, and emergency retrieval process
messages:
From: BrightFin Security <security@brightfin.com>
To: grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Date: 2026-09-01T10:12:00Z
Subject: Question on audit log exportability and retention

Hi Grace,

We're doing an internal compliance review and need a clear statement of how Redwood exposes audit and access logs for tenants. Specifically: 
- What are the default retention windows for tenant-level audit logs and access logs?
- Can we request a one-off export of raw logs (UTC timestamped JSON or CSV) for a custom date range?
- If so, what's the typical lead time and delivery format?
- For emergency/legal holds, can you perform an ad-hoc snapshot and freeze deletes for a tenant? Any SLA around that?

Thanks — looking to capture this in our evidence pack.

Regards,
Adrian Park
Security Engineer
BrightFin Financial

From: grace_oconnor@redwood.com
To: BrightFin Security <security@brightfin.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-09-01T14:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Question on audit log exportability and retention

Hi Adrian — thanks for the note and the clear list of asks. Below is a concise summary; attaching our export playbook with examples.

Quick answers up front:
- Default retention: audit events (admin activity, config changes): 13 months by default in hosted; access traces (API call records, token usage): 6 months default.
- One-off exports: yes — we provide raw JSON or gzipped CSV exports for arbitrary UTC ranges up to retention window.
- Lead time: self-service via Console for exports < 7 days of range; scheduled/large extractions typically 24–72 hours depending on volume.
- Emergency snapshots/legal hold: we support snap-and-freeze workflows for Dedicated and Private customers; for hosted customers we can stage a snapshot and halt automated retention purge within a 24–48 hour SLA for critical requests (subject to contract).

Attachment highlights: sample manifest format, expected egress packaging, and checksums.

I'll loop Karthik for the technical export details and Marissa for any billing/contract exceptions.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Head of Customer Security Operations
Redwood Inference

2) For the console self-service export: does the output include the full event payload (actor, IP, request path, tenant_id, request_id) or is any field redacted?
3) For emergency snapshot freeze: do you produce an attestation document that shows purge processes were suspended and a copy of the exported artifacts? Our auditors require proof of non-deletion.

Would like to capture this in the BrightFin evidence binder by COB next Wednesday.

Cheers,
Adrian

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: Adrian Park <adrian.park@brightfin.com>, grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-09-02T15:10:00Z
Subject: Re: Question on audit log exportability and retention

Hi Adrian — quick technical clarifications as requested:

1) Retention configurability: Hosted tenants can request a retention policy change as an add-on (we retain auxiliary archives for extended retention up to 24 months; this is a contract amendment). Dedicated and Private deployments give you full control over retention windows via your config UI or on-prem policies.

2) Export contents: Exports contain full event payloads by default (timestamp_utc, tenant_id, actor_id, actor_email when available, source_ip, request_path, request_id, response_code, raw_metadata). We do redact secrets (authorization headers, token values) and PII fields if the tenant has data-masking enabled — masking rules are customer-configurable and are recorded in the manifest.

3) Attestation and freeze playbook: yes — for emergency legal holds we produce a signed freeze attestation (PDF) that lists the subject tenant, snapshot time, nitty-gritty of the retention freeze, and a manifest of exported files (checksums included). We hold exported artifacts on an encrypted staging bucket and can produce chain-of-custody logs. The standard SLA for initiating a freeze and producing attestation is 48 hours for hosted customers; 24 hours for Dedicated/Private per enterprise SLAs.

I've attached the export manifest CSV sample and the short playbook excerpt in the thread attachment. If you want we can schedule a 30-minute walkthrough to show the export workflow in the Console.

— Karthik
Senior Product Manager, Data Compliance
Redwood Inference
